items.html: Now the thirteen corrections of the beard (Tikkunei Dikna) are the secret of the encompassing [lights] of the face, in the manner that we shall explain, with God's help. For the matter is that it is true that in the aspect of the inner light (Or Pnimi) there are ten Sefirot of the Keter and ten Sefirot of the Hochma; but in the secret of the encompassing [light] there are only thirteen encompassing [lights] of the Keter and of the Hochma alone, for the rest cannot be revealed.
